meta.title: 哪怕是在户外，也要学会控光哦。

scenes.context: 阳光直射脸部产生明显的硬边阴影，而电影人物面部光影柔和。
sentences: 当阳光直射在脸上的时候。
When sunlight hits your face directly.
directly（直接地）
面部会有很明显的硬边阴影。
It creates harsh, hard-edged shadows.
harsh（刺眼的）
他们的面部光影都很柔和。
Their faces have soft, gentle light.
soft（柔和的）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达直射问题
Direct sun throws a sharp shadow across your face.
换种说法表达电影柔光
On screen, faces are wrapped in soft light.
scenes.speak: When sunlight hits your face directly, it creates harsh, hard-edged shadows. On screen, faces are wrapped in soft, gentle light.

scenes.title_cn: 方法一与二：阴凉处、背光+反光板
scenes.title_en: Method 1 and 2: Shade, and Backlight with Bounce
scenes.context: 找阴凉处避免直射但背景别是天空；背光拍摄脸黑用反光板补光。
sentences: 找一个阴亮的地方拍摄。
Shoot somewhere shaded and bright.
shaded（阴凉的）
整个场景的光比会很大。
The scene has a huge contrast ratio.
contrast ratio（光比）
你可以拿一个反光板。
You can grab a bounce board.
bounce board（反光板）
这样脸上的光就会很柔和了。
The light on your face becomes soft again.
become soft（变柔和）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达阴凉处拍摄
Pick a spot that's out of the sun but still bright.
换种说法表达反光板补光
Use a reflector to bounce light back onto your face.
scenes.speak: Shoot somewhere shaded and bright. Watch out for a huge contrast ratio. If you shoot against the light, grab a bounce board so the light on your face becomes soft again.

scenes.context: 在太阳与人之间放柔光屏，太阳光变柔和但会降低亮度。
sentences: 在太阳跟你之间 放一个柔光屏。
Put a diffusion screen between you and the sun.
diffusion（扩散）
这样太阳光就会变得很柔和了。
It softens the sunlight.
soften（软化）
你可能需要重新调整你的曝光了。
You may need to re-adjust your exposure.
exposure（曝光）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达柔光屏原理
A screen between you and the sun scatters its light.
换种说法表达曝光调整
Expect to rebalance your exposure afterward.
scenes.speak: Put a diffusion screen between you and the sun. It softens the sunlight, so you may need to re-adjust your exposure.

scenes.title_en: Method 4: Fill Light in the Shade
scenes.context: 树影下背景可以是天空，只要面前补一盏大功率灯；白天补光要 100W 级。
sentences: 你也可以待在影影下。
You can also stay in the shade.
shade（树影、阴凉）
在你前面 补一盏灯就可以了。
Just add one fill light in front of you.
fill light（补光灯）
像那种10瓦20瓦的便携式补光灯 在白天补了跟没补是一样的。
A 10W or 20W portable light makes no difference in daylight.
make no difference（毫无差别）
我自己这个是100瓦的补光灯。
Mine is a 100-watt fill light.
watt（瓦）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达树影下补光
In the shade, a single light in front does the job.
换种说法表达功率要求
Small portable lights are useless in the daytime.
scenes.speak: You can also stay in the shade and add one fill light in front of you. A 10W or 20W portable light makes no difference in daylight. Mine is a 100-watt fill light.

practice: Direct sun creates harsh, hard-edged shadows.
The scene has a huge contrast ratio.
A diffusion screen softens the sunlight.
A 20W light makes no difference in daylight.
pitfalls: 以为阴凉处随意拍就行
天空会让光比过大，人脸发黑
反光板把光反射回脸上就柔和了
白天环境光强，小灯等于没补
柔光屏减光后不调曝光
柔光屏降亮度，曝光要重设
shifts: 看到强光就拍，脸有硬边阴影
认准 100W 级内置电池灯
四法组合：阴凉、反光板、柔光屏、补光灯
footer_notes: 来源：哪怕是在户外，也要学会控光哦。（小红书，时长3分04秒）
